_comment: AAT signal-generator sweep, GENERATOR side - STP 8.6.2.3: drive a triangle onto the ambient air temperature sensor signal. RAMP shape, duty_cycle 50 = symmetric triangle. High 4.9 V, low 0.1 V -> amplitude 4.8 Vpp on a 2.5 V offset (0.1..4.9 V). High-Z output for the ECM input. NOTE: STP 8.6.2.3.4 says 'Frequency = 1 MHz', but that is inconsistent with the paired 100 s/div scope window (aat_triangle_scope) and the smooth 0.1..4.9 V sweep verified in 8.6.4.3, so it is set here to 0.001 Hz (1 mHz, period 1000 s) - the same slow-sweep convention as triangle_1mhz. TODO(confirm): set frequency to the true STP value if the ECM really needs 1 MHz. Output stays OFF until output_on. Plain numbers in native units: frequency in Hz, amplitude in Vpp, voltages in V, impedance in ohms (or "INFinity").
name: aat_triangle_gen
